text: Campaign finance reports show Missouri Republicans with more money than Democrats for the final push of the midterm election, even as Democrats predict wins in tight legislative races. Follow the money, and it leads to a lot of yard signs.

Some rural Missouri interstates will soon go from 70 to 75 miles per hour, after the Missouri Department of Transportation picked the stretches allowed under a new state law. Cruise control fans, this one's for you.

Missouri's State Board of Education is split over the state's plan to give every public school and district an A-through-F grade, with St. Louis County member Vincent Schoemehl Jr. questioning whether it will help struggling schools at the Oct. 20 meeting. Now the schools know how report card day feels.

Missouri Interim Education Commissioner Stacey Preis resigned Oct. 20, effective immediately, announcing it during a break in the State Board of Education meeting in Jefferson City while the board searches for a permanent leader. The job listing just got a little more urgent.

Patrick Mahomes earned his 100th career win as the Kansas City Chiefs beat the Los Angeles Chargers 22-6 in October to go 5-0, one of three unbeaten teams in the NFL. Perfect record, perfect Monday mood.

No. 9 Ole Miss beat No. 13 Missouri 31-3 in Oxford, Mississippi, in October, as the Tigers managed only a field goal despite twice getting inside the Ole Miss 10-yard line. The end zone was right there, too.
